values: Audit of Data/PCN_data_ext_checking_v.3.csv against the protocol and available study evidence
207 effect-size rows, 72 original columns, 16 studies; all primary PDFs inventoried; 106 figure-sourced rows reconciled to MetaDigitise; 92 rows reconciled to available author/prepared workbooks.
The source CSV was read only. SHA-256: 0bd770a4f117ead932c53b282c823a312a1526170c49f83623c8a7bb9b59a0fc
Each row in All flags is one cell-level finding. Multiple flags may concern the same effect-size row. Counts are therefore flags, not distinct erroneous rows.
Confirmed = directly supported by protocol/source or a deterministic calculation. Review = source ambiguity or a modeling/variance decision remains.

High = changes a value, sample size, pairing/identifier, exposure, outcome unit/type, or analysis-critical statistic. Medium = source traceability, protocol placement, or a material schema issue. Low = controlled-vocabulary/case/spelling cleanup.
Start with Priority flags, then inspect the matching reconciliation tabs. Do not bulk-apply low-priority changes before resolving high-priority pairings/statistics.

PDF methods/tables and all available digital sources were checked. Author-email values without a saved file remain review items. Visual figure extraction precision is limited by the saved MetaDigitise calibration.
All 14 rows use author raw data, but each control arm is summarized from the opposite sex while the experimental arm matches offspring_sex. Six figure-labelled rows also cite the wrong source type.
Replace control summaries with the same-sex author subgroup; correct source/file fields.
44 stored SE values are inconsistent with SD/sqrt(n); es162 also has a source-SD mismatch.
Use the verified SD and n to recompute SE; correct es162 ex_sd first.
Sex-coded c_a_id/ex_a_id/comparison values conflict with the paired source rows; mean-grooming units/types are also wrong.
117 field flags across 39 rows; 4 unit/type rows
Rebuild identifiers from source sex/group and correct mean-grooming duration to time in seconds.
Exposure is white/broadband 0-20 kHz, not ultrasound 0-2,000 Hz.
Correct noise category and frequency before deriving acoustic moderators.
45 min/day was entered as 0.66 h, and CON/PSN sample sizes are reversed.
Set duration to 0.75 h and sample sizes to control 10 / exposed 9.
SD=sqrt(mean) is an explicit assumption because the figure error bars are undefined.
Make a documented sensitivity-analysis decision; this is not a transcription correction.
Two author-email sucrose rows lack a supporting file, and four Figure 3b/3c screenshot filenames are transposed.
Archive the author source and correct the four screenshot stems.
